meta.title: Voyager's Wake
meta.subtitle: Where gravity dies, legend begins
meta.description: A relentless camera plunge from Earth's thin blue veil to the very edge of the Sun's domain — 122 AU of pure visual violence.

chapters.label: Earth Orbit
chapters.title: THE BLUE MARBLE
chapters.subtitle: Fragile. Finite. Ours.
paragraphs: 400 km up. The Pacific swallows the sun — a wall of incandescent copper detonating across 165 million square kilometers of black mirror.
ISS knifes through terminator at 7.66 km/s. Solar arrays glow like shattered glass. Below: typhoon eyes, copper rivers, the aneurysms of megacities pulsing in sodium light.

chapters.label: Moon Flyby
chapters.title: THE SILENT WITNESS
chapters.subtitle: No wind. No water. No mercy.
paragraphs: Far side rolls into view — a slaughterhouse of impacts. South Pole–Aitken: 2,500 km of cosmic violence, 8 km deep, 4.3 billion years fresh.
Regolith so fine it holds a bootprint for a million years. No atmosphere to erase. No life to mourn. Just rock remembering every blow.

chapters.label: Mars Approach
chapters.title: THE RUST HORIZON
chapters.subtitle: A corpse that once breathed.
paragraphs: Olympus Mons: 22 km of shield volcano. Its caldera could swallow Manhattan. Flanks so shallow you'd walk into orbit.
Valles Marineris rips the equator — 4,000 km long, 7 km deep. The Grand Canyon is a drainage ditch by comparison.
Dust devils pirouette across Amazonis. The north pole cap retreats, exposing layered ice — climate history written in CO₂ and water.

chapters.label: Asteroid Belt
chapters.title: THE SHATTERED PLANET
chapters.subtitle: Jupiter said no.
paragraphs: Not a swarm. A void punctuated by betrayal. Millions of km between neighbors — you'd never see another from the surface.
Ceres: 940 km of differentiated world. Occator's faculae scream sodium carbonate — briny cryovolcanism in perpetual night.
Vesta's Rheasilvia basin: one impact blew 1% of its mass into space. HED meteorites on Earth are its ghosts.

chapters.label: Jupiter System
chapters.title: THE KING'S COURT
chapters.subtitle: Pressure makes diamonds. Here it makes metal hydrogen.
paragraphs: The Great Red Spot: anticyclone wider than Earth, raging 350+ years. Winds 430 km/h. Roots plunge 300 km — we just learned that.
Io: most volcanic body in the system. Tidal flexing melts its guts. Pele's plume arcs 300 km. Surface repaves itself in centuries.
Europa: chaos terrain, cycloidal ridges, a global ocean with more water than Earth. The ice shell flexes. Something swims below.
Ganymede: only moon with a magnetic field. Its own magnetosphere inside Jupiter's. Callisto: the oldest face in the solar system, crater-saturated, dead.

chapters.label: Saturn Rings
chapters.title: THE JEWEL BOX
chapters.subtitle: A billion trillion diamonds. Ten meters thick.
paragraphs: A-ring edge: Janus and Epimetheus swap orbits every 4 years, carving 15 km waves. Density waves spiral like vinyl grooves.
Cassini Division: Mimas' 2:1 resonance sweeps it clean. But it's not empty — ghost particles drift in the dark.
B-ring core: 99% pure water ice. Spokes — radial fingers of charged dust — levitate on magnetic fields, rotating with Saturn's 10.7-hour heartbeat.
F-ring: Prometheus and Pandora shepherd a braided rope of ice. Prometheus steals streamers every 68 days. Violence in slow motion.

chapters.label: Heliopause
chapters.title: THE FINAL SHORE
chapters.subtitle: The Sun's last breath. The galaxy's first inhale.
paragraphs: 122 AU. Termination shock behind us — solar wind slammed from supersonic to subsonic in a cosmic hydraulic jump.
Heliosheath: magnetic foam, turbulence, the Sun's wind piling against the interstellar gale. Plasma density jumps 40×.
Voyager 1 crossed August 25, 2012. Voyager 2, November 5, 2018. 23 watts. 22 billion km. The signal arrives at 10⁻¹⁸ watts.
Beyond: pristine galactic plasma. Cold. Dense. Magnetic field draped around our bubble like wind over stone. We are outside. We are still talking.
